ALMIOET · OCCUPATIONAL ENGLISH TEST

Speech Pathology OET — practice and recognition

Practise the OET for speech pathology using real clinical scenarios, not general academic topics. Get an honest grade for each sub-test so you know exactly where you stand before test day. 46 organisations across 11 countries recognise OET for Speech Pathology.

Start 7-day free trial$12/month · 7-day free trial · never copied from OET

Real clinical feedback, not flattering scores

OET grades you on professional communication across Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking. AlmiOET grades your responses against healthcare communication rubrics — if your referral letter layout is weak or your consultation pacing is off, we tell you exactly what to fix. Honest assessments, original material, and a clear view of where you stand.

Listening & Reading

Auto-marked on the real 0–500 scale, in healthcare contexts.

Speech Pathology Writing

AI feedback on letter layout, case selection and clinical relevance.

Clinical Speaking

Role-play feedback on patient communication — never on accent.

Most regulators ask for Grade B (350) in each sub-test; some accept C+ (300) or set their own per-sub-test rules. Always confirm the exact requirement with the organisation you're applying to.

FAQ

Who accepts OET for Speech Pathology?
OET's official list shows 46 organisations recognising OET for Speech Pathology across 11 countries — regulators, boards, councils and employers. Always confirm the exact requirement with your own regulator.
What OET grade do I need for Speech Pathology?
Most regulators ask for Grade B (350) in each sub-test; some accept C+ (300) or set their own per-sub-test rules. Always confirm the exact requirement with the organisation you're applying to.
Which professions does AlmiOET cover?
All 12 OET professions — Nursing, Medicine, Dentistry, Dietetics, Occupational Therapy, Optometry, Pharmacy, Physiotherapy, Podiatry, Radiography, Speech Pathology, Veterinary Science. Writing and Speaking are tailored to your profession; Listening and Reading are shared.
Is AlmiOET affiliated with OET?
No. AlmiOET is independent and not affiliated with OET or CBLA. All practice material is original and never copied from the Occupational English Test.

How many organisations accept OET for Speech Pathology?

Does OET registration replace a visa for someone from Afghanistan?
No. OET supports professional registration; a visa is a separate process. Check both for your route.

Dubai Healthcare City Authority

Government · United Arab Emirates

AlmiOET · OET recognition

Speech Pathology OET requirement for Australian Department of Home Affairs — from Afghanistan

Healthcare professionals applying from Afghanistan usually need to prove their English separately from their qualifications. OET is built for exactly that — clinical communication, not general academic English.

Organisation

Australian Department of Home Affairs

Government · Australia

Required OET grade

Listening B · Reading B · Writing B · Speaking B

Per sub-test on the 0–500 scale. Practice estimate only.

If you trained in Afghanistan and are pursuing speech pathology registration recognised by Australian Department of Home Affairs, OET is the healthcare-specific English test built for clinical communication — referral letters, patient consultations, and workplace listening and reading.

Most regulators ask for Grade B (350) in each sub-test; some accept C+ (300) or set their own per-sub-test rules. Always confirm the exact requirement with the organisation you're applying to.

Australian Department of Home Affairs also recognises OET for: Dentistry, Dietetics, Medicine, Nursing, Occupational Therapy, Optometry, Pharmacy, Podiatry, Veterinary Science, Radiography, Physiotherapy.

Official organisation page: immi.homeaffairs.gov.au/help-support/meeting-our-requirements/english-language

See every profession Australian Department of Home Affairs recognises →

FAQ

Does Australian Department of Home Affairs accept OET for Speech Pathology?
Yes — Australian Department of Home Affairs is on OET's official list of recognising organisations for Speech Pathology. The published requirement is Listening B · Reading B · Writing B · Speaking B. Always check the current requirement on the organisation's own page.
What OET grade do I need for Australian Department of Home Affairs?
OET lists Listening B · Reading B · Writing B · Speaking B for Australian Department of Home Affairs. Most regulators ask for Grade B (350) in each sub-test; some accept C+ (300) or set their own per-sub-test rules. Always confirm the exact requirement with the organisation you're applying to.
Is OET registration the same as a visa?
No. OET evidence supports professional registration with a regulator or body like Australian Department of Home Affairs. A visa is a separate step. Confirm both routes for your situation.

Speech Pathology OET requirement for Regulatory College of Audiologists and Speech-Language Pathologists of New Brunswick — from Albania

Healthcare professionals applying from Albania usually need to prove their English separately from their qualifications. OET is built for exactly that — clinical communication, not general academic English.

Organisation

Regulatory College of Audiologists and Speech-Language Pathologists of New Brunswick

Healthcare regulator · Canada

Required OET grade

Listening B · Reading B · Writing B · Speaking B

Per sub-test on the 0–500 scale. Practice estimate only.

If you trained in Albania and are pursuing speech pathology registration recognised by Regulatory College of Audiologists and Speech-Language Pathologists of New Brunswick, OET is the healthcare-specific English test built for clinical communication — referral letters, patient consultations, and workplace listening and reading.

Most regulators ask for Grade B (350) in each sub-test; some accept C+ (300) or set their own per-sub-test rules. Always confirm the exact requirement with the organisation you're applying to.

Official organisation page: rcaslpnb.ca/

See every profession Regulatory College of Audiologists and Speech-Language Pathologists of New Brunswick recognises →

FAQ

Does Regulatory College of Audiologists and Speech-Language Pathologists of New Brunswick accept OET for Speech Pathology?
Yes — Regulatory College of Audiologists and Speech-Language Pathologists of New Brunswick is on OET's official list of recognising organisations for Speech Pathology. The published requirement is Listening B · Reading B · Writing B · Speaking B. Always check the current requirement on the organisation's own page.
What OET grade do I need for Regulatory College of Audiologists and Speech-Language Pathologists of New Brunswick?
OET lists Listening B · Reading B · Writing B · Speaking B for Regulatory College of Audiologists and Speech-Language Pathologists of New Brunswick. Most regulators ask for Grade B (350) in each sub-test; some accept C+ (300) or set their own per-sub-test rules. Always confirm the exact requirement with the organisation you're applying to.
Is OET registration the same as a visa?
No. OET evidence supports professional registration with a regulator or body like Regulatory College of Audiologists and Speech-Language Pathologists of New Brunswick. A visa is a separate step. Confirm both routes for your situation.

Important — how the test must be taken

For immigration applications, Immigration New Zealand accepts OET only when every part of the test was taken in person at a supervised test centre — this applies from midnight 12 July 2026 (NZST). If you completed a computer-based OET with a remotely administered speaking component before 13 July 2026, you can still use those results. The requirement applies to OET only, not to other English language tests, and it is Immigration New Zealand's own acceptance rule — OET's test format has not changed.

Speech Pathology OET requirement for Teesside University — from Albania

Healthcare professionals applying from Albania usually need to prove their English separately from their qualifications. OET is built for exactly that — clinical communication, not general academic English.

Organisation

Teesside University

Education · United Kingdom

Required OET grade

Listening B · Reading B · Writing B · Speaking B

Per sub-test on the 0–500 scale. Practice estimate only.

If you trained in Albania and are pursuing speech pathology registration recognised by Teesside University, OET is the healthcare-specific English test built for clinical communication — referral letters, patient consultations, and workplace listening and reading.

Most regulators ask for Grade B (350) in each sub-test; some accept C+ (300) or set their own per-sub-test rules. Always confirm the exact requirement with the organisation you're applying to.

Teesside University also recognises OET for: Dentistry, Dietetics, Medicine, Nursing, Occupational Therapy, Optometry, Pharmacy, Physiotherapy, Podiatry, Radiography, Veterinary Science.

Official organisation page: www.tees.ac.uk

Yes — The University of Sheffield is on OET's official list of recognising organisations for Speech Pathology. The published requirement is Listening C+ · Reading C+ · Writing C+ · Speaking C+. Always check the current requirement on the organisation's own page.
What OET grade do I need for The University of Sheffield?
OET lists Listening C+ · Reading C+ · Writing C+ · Speaking C+ for The University of Sheffield. Most regulators ask for Grade B (350) in each sub-test; some accept C+ (300) or set their own per-sub-test rules. Always confirm the exact requirement with the organisation you're applying to.
Is OET registration the same as a visa?
No. OET evidence supports professional registration with a regulator or body like The University of Sheffield. A visa is a separate step. Confirm both routes for your situation.
